tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “O teu médico ajuda toda a gente. Como é ele?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Most adjectives go after the noun: um carro vermelho. A few can go before it to give an opinion: uma boa ideia, um mau dia, um grande homem. Some change meaning with position: um grande homem (great) and um homem grande (big). Santo becomes são before a masculine name: São João. Only the blue verb changes. A tile in brackets such as (eu) says who is meant; you don’t write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Um grande homem ou um homem grande?
tandemRedemittel.p2: Um grande homem: admirável. Um homem grande: de grande estatura.
